remarks: Enjoy the SONO lifestyle in this oversized 1-bedroom right in the heart of downtown! Just steps from the Maritime Aquarium, IMAX Theater, vibrant bars and restaurants, and the new SoNo Collection mall. Enjoy easy access to the South Norwalk train station and just a short drive to Norwalk's beautiful beaches. Inside, the unit offers an updated kitchen with stainless steel appliances, a stylish tile bathroom, and a spacious living room with exposed brick and abundant natural light. French doors open to your private bedroom with adjoining bath access. Additional features include central air and an in-unit washer/dryer. Parking is available in the Haviland Lot for $75 per month. Don't miss this opportunity!
